report.summary: daedalus/doctor.py: Readiness check module that probes local dependencies (Ollama, Codex CLI, Claude CLI, DeepSeek API key) and watcher heartbeat to determine if the system can offload real work to local execution.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/doctor.py|all probes are read-only (HTTP GET + PATH lookups); nothing is started or installed.
CLAIMS|daedalus/doctor.py|codex_status probes are cheap and non-interactive, never triggering a login flow or model call.
todos: daedalus/doctor.py|function|codex_status|Returns dict with presence, version, logged_in, refused for Codex CLI; handles BudgetRefused separately.
daedalus/doctor.py|function|check|Returns dict summarizing readiness: claude_cli, codex_cli, ollama_up, host, model desired/present, deepseek_key, can_offload_local.
daedalus/doctor.py|function|main|Prints human-readable doctor report with color-coded statuses and watcher heartbeat info.
